question: To shake or tremble in voice
solution: Her voice began to quaver as she told the emotional story. बोलते समय आवाज़ का कांपना या थरथराना।

question: The minimum number of people needed for a meeting
solution: The board meeting was cancelled as there was no quorum. किसी सभा या बैठक को वैध बनाने के लिए आवश्यक न्यूनतम सदस्यों की संख्या।

question: A feather used as a pen
solution: Before fountain pens were invented, authors wrote with a quill. पक्षी के पंख से बनी पुराने समय की कलम।

question: Changing quickly and unpredictably
solution: Her quicksilver personality made it hard to know what she was thinking. पारे (mercury) की तरह बहुत जल्दी और अनिश्चित रूप से बदलने वाला (अस्थिर)।

question: To the utmost or most absolute extent or degree
solution: It is quite impossible to finish this task in one hour. पूरी तरह से या पूर्ण रूप से।

question: Unrealistically optimistic or idealistic
solution: He has many quixotic ideas about changing the world overnight. ख्याली या ऐसी योजना जो बहुत ही अवास्तविक (idealistic) हो।

question: A court or open space, usually rectangular, enclosed by a building
solution: Students gathered in the college quadrangle for the announcement. एक चतुर्भुजाकार खुला प्रांगण जो इमारतों से घिरा हो।

question: To reject as invalid, especially by legal procedure
solution: The judge decided to quash the previous conviction. किसी कानूनी कार्यवाही या फैसले को अमान्य ठहराकर रद्द करना।

question: The sound made by ducks; A person who pretends to have more knowledge than he actually possesses
solution: A quack is the characteristic sound of a duck or a person who dishonestly claims to have medical skills. बतख की आवाज़ या एक ऐसा व्यक्ति जो ज्ञान न होने पर भी डॉक्टर होने का ढोंग करे (झोलाछाप)।

question: A search for something
solution: The knights went on a long quest to find the holy grail. किसी चीज़ की लंबी या कठिन खोज (तलाश)।

question: A creature with four feet
solution: A horse is a quadruped animal. चार पैरों वाला कोई भी जीव या पशु (चौपाया)।

question: Occurring once every five years
solution: The census in some countries is a quinquennial event. हर पाँच साल में एक बार होने वाली घटना (पंचवार्षिक)।

question: A situation in which you are confused about what to do
solution: He was in a quandary about whether to accept the job offer or not. ऐसी स्थिति जहाँ व्यक्ति उलझन या दुविधा (confused) में हो कि क्या करना चाहिए।

question: The 500th anniversary of an event
solution: The city celebrated its quincentenary with a massive parade. किसी ऐतिहासिक घटना या स्थापना की 500वीं वर्षगांठ।

question: A stanza or poem of four lines
solution: Many traditional hymns are written in quatrains. कविता या पद्य की चार पंक्तियों का समूह (चौपाई)।
